Priya Nair: Heads-up: product launch embargo needs a regional split. US/Eastern lift stays 09:30 ET, but EU outlets ask for 14:00 CEST. We need two slightly different assets (localized quotes + metric rounding).

Tori Lee: Got it. We'll prepare two social packages. EU posts should use the localized headline and metric in EUR context where relevant. Who's owning translations?

Marco Giannini: Localization team will translate the press release and the 2-line CEO quote. ETA: 2 hours. I'll add translator notes for the benchmark phrasing.

Priya Nair: Perfect. PressOps  please hold outbound to EU until 14:00 CEST and US until 09:30 ET. Also, don't auto-syndicate to partner channels; partners need explicit OK post-embargo.

PressOps Bot: Acknowledged. Scheduling two sends: 2026-07-21T09:30:00-04:00 (US) and 2026-07-21T14:00:00+02:00 (EU). Partners hold flag set.

Sam Ortega: OpsBot  can you ensure the CDN asset cache is purged right after each embargo lift? Last time SVG updated but old cached version served.

OpsBot: CDN purge scheduled at embargo lifts. Also will verify public livestream link is accessible 30 min before first lift.

LegalBot: Note: For EU publications, avoid comparative phrases referencing specific vendor names. Use neutral phrasing per compliance. We'll push a short approved addendum for the localized release. Clearance in 45m.

Tori Lee: Social calendar: primary US tweet 09:35 ET, EU thread at 14:05 CEST. We should add a pinned reply with the corrected methodology link for both. Who has the final methodology link?

Priya Nair: Link is https://go.redwood/optimize-methods-2026. Marco, include the link in translations.

Marco Giannini: Will include and verify the link resolves to localized anchors. Also flag any currencies shown in tables.

Sam Ortega: Ops confirm livestream link public check at 08:50 ET and 13:20 CEST. I'll post confirmation in this thread once verified.

Priya Nair: Also small ask: CTO would like the technical appendix excerpt included for tech outlets. It's cleared by Engineering but Legal wants a short disclaimer added. Marco + LegalBot coordinate on wording.

LegalBot: We'll add the standard disclaimer: "Performance results represent internal testing under specified conditions; actual results may vary." Use that exact sentence in both localized releases.

Tori Lee: For journalists who request embargoed early access, route to me and Priya. We will not approve early access without exec sign-off.

Priya Nair: Final checklist items added to the doc: localized press release, localized quote, methodology link verified, CDN purge, partner hold, exec availability confirmed. No content edits after Legal sign-off.

PressOps Bot: Internal reminder set: legal sign-off cutoff 2026-07-21T08:45:00-04:00 (US) and 2026-07-21T13:15:00+02:00 (EU). Outreach schedules locked. :white_check_mark:

OpsBot: Livestream link checked at 08:50 ET: public. Also pre-cleared CDN purge hooks in place.

Priya Nair: Brilliant. If anyone sees press pushing early, ping me immediately and do not respond to quote requests without direction. Thanks team.
